notes.title: Guilty Gear X2 #Reload releases on Steam!
notes.content:
[URL=http://store.steampowered.com/app/314030/][img]http://i.imgur.com/n83zrlG.jpg[/img][/URL]

ArcSys' presence on Steam grows ever stronger with the Steam release of [i]Guilty Gear X2 #Reload[/i], Guilty Gear Isuka's turn-buttonless big sister! Click the banner above to check it out.

In the next few days, we'll be looking into bundling #Reload with the same sort of bonuses that we've packaged with Isuka. #Reload's soundtrack is already included at no extra cost, and Steam Trading Cards are forthcoming. Beyond that, there may be more on the horizon...

Thank you all for giving your support to these older titles; KISS and Funbox aren't the only people who appreciate it.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qD5MAr5.png[/img]

notes.title: Guilty Gear Isuka Update - OST now included!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FTA7de3.jpg[/img]

As of today's update, [i]Guilty Gear Isuka[/i] now comes bundled with its official Original Soundtrack, complete with tags and cover art. Encoded in MP3 at over double the bitrate of the OGG files used ingame, you should find these a little more pleasant on the ears and convenient for the playlists. You can find the soundtrack in the [i]GUILTY GEAR ISUKA[/i] folder in your steam/steamapps/common directory.

Stay tuned in the coming weeks...

notes.title: Heaven or Hell, let's... trade?
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/liYY3XN.jpg[/img]

[i]As of today, Guilty Gear Isuka has Steam Trading Cards![/i]

You will now occasionally receive trading card drops while playing Guilty Gear Isuka, of which a full set can be crafted into rewards such as Steam badges, emoticons, and backgrounds. Plaster Potemkin on your Steam profile, annoy your friends with a relentless barrage of donuts (just as Faust would want it), sell your foil Bridget card and buy a hundred copies of Bad Rats with the profit; the possibilities are endless!

This is our way of saying thanks to the loyal fans of Guilty Gear, who supported Guilty Gear Isuka's Steam debut despite the rough release. We're still looking into doing more substantial things with GGI in the future, but in the mean time we hope you enjoy this little token of our appreciation. 

We still have more planned for Guilty Gear Isuka, more on that in the coming days.

notes.title: Guilty Gear Isuka Update
notes.content:
Today we've made a few changes to how Steam handles Guilty Gear Isuka. Guilty Gear Isuka's configuration menu can now be used through Steam by choosing "Configure Settings" on startup. 

Additionally, Guilty Gear Isuka now makes use of Steam Cloud saving; saved data such as boost points, factory unlocks, and in-game/config menu settings can be accessed from any computer as long as you have cloud saving enabled.

We have a few more things planned in the future as well, and hope to keep you posted on them!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Guilty Gear Isuka, 10% off!
notes.content:
Guilty Gear Isuka is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off*!

Welcome in a brand new tournament where you will have to defeat redoubtable opponents in amazing fights. A new gear, the strong Leopaldon, is threatening the world and you will have to stop him!
Other modes are included, like Robo-Ky II Factory, where you can customize your Robo-Ky II and improve its skills and techniques, and GG Boost Mode, a side scrolling adventure where your character will have to defeat waves of enemies increasingly powerful! The classic Guilty Gear atmosphere is still there, and you will be very familiar with voices, sound effects, heavy metal soundtrack, animations, backgrounds and characters designed by Daisuke Ishiwatari!

*Offer ends January 23rd at 10AM Pacific time.
